name: Ithaenc Cathedral and Falls
title: Ithaenc Cathedral
summary: The cathedral on Ithaenc Island in the Vesayen Isles, beside the Ithaenc waterfalls, which acpedia calls one of the biggest in Dereth. In the kit, a ruined Gothic complex stands on a cliff-top plateau at z 160 amid flower gardens and Adja's Well: a 54 m church, a 54 m seven-storey south tower, an eight-storey arched hall, a broken six-storey tower and a hexagonal spire (tops z 193-214). Beside it, a sky-pool spills north over a 60 m cliff into a middle pool at z 100, with Waterfall effects at its foot. The middle pool drops a further 100 m to the sea.

landmarks.name: South tower (0x01001FB7)
landmarks.note: Mossy seven-storey hall with a tapered roof.

Derived ground drop on the cathedral plateau 12 m from the anchor (ground 160.0), 6.2 m from any drawn object, 27 m from the Catacombs of Ithaenc portal (which stands 36 m higher). Cell index = floor(lx/24)*8+floor(ly/24)+1, z = ground + 0.5.]

shots.standingOrder: Hang 25 m over the middle pool looking down at the churning water, then tilt up the 60 m Ithaenc falls to the cathedral towers on the cliff above; hold position, nothing within 20 m.
shots.notes: Tilt reveal from a hover 25 m over the middle pool. The frame starts looking down at the churning water and tilts up the 60 m Ithaenc falls, where the Waterfall effects foam at its foot, to the cathedral's towers on the cliff above. The midday sun (0.56) is high to the south, so the spray is backlit. The edit window begins as the falls enter the frame, and the reveal is the defining moment.
